text:
Ana: Quick sync 2 Redwood + XenonSys agreed to run a joint heatmap pulse to map perf/W vs p95 latency across our kernel patches. Goal: identify the best tradeoffs for long-sequence (8k) workloads and thermal headroom. Target start: next Tue. Who's in?
Shreya: I'm in. Can we lock the measurement goals? I want steady-state throughput, p95 p99 latencies, sampled power, and where thermal throttling kicks in. Also need a telemetry schema and sample rate.
Mike: +1. We'll provide the kernel variants (baseline, patch-A, patch-B) and a quantized variant. Need RAW power logs (RAPL/IPMI) and per-socket temps. Also would prefer per-token timing where possible.
Kyle: Proposal for run matrix (so we can budget time): models = {avalon-small, avalon-medium}; seq = {2048, 8192}; batch = {1,4}; kernel = {baseline,patch-A,patch-B,quant}. Roughly 32 experiments per node * 3 repeats = ~96 runs. Expect ~6-8 hours per node for full sweep depending on stable temps.
Shreya: Good call. Also add a small bucket for sustained-power burn-in (30m) to find thermal plateau before each variant.
Mike: Draft run command I will land in infra repo: 
```
./run_heatmap.sh --model avalon-medium --seq 8192 --batch 1 --kernel patch-B --out s3://redwood-heatmaps/xenon/1792468222/
```
It will collect: stdout logs, per-process perf counters, ipmi/power samples, and upload a stream tarball.
benchbot: CI note: please tag artifacts with run-id and include a `meta.json` containing partner, rack, kernel, model, seq, batch. Benchbot will assert schema before upload.
Ana: Logistics: XenonSys will ship 2 reference nodes to our lab for instrumented runs; we'll also do a remote rack run in their datacenter for a production-ambient comparison. Shreya 2 please coordinate shipping + NDA checklist. Mike/Kyle 2 confirm scripts and matrix by EOD Fri.
Shreya: I'll open a shared spreadsheet with the matrix + column for "priority runs" and "must-capture metrics". Also adding a column for "therm setup" (ambient, fan-profile, heatsink).
Kyle: I'll produce the CSV and attach expected runtime per cell. Will include a quick script to parse the tarballs into a heatmap-ready CSV for visualization (power vs throughput).
Mike: One more: let's capture kernel trace for the heavy runs (1 in 6) so we can spot contention or stalls. I'll add `trace=true` toggle to run script.
Ravi: From XenonSys: we'll provide a compact flange for per-socket thermocouples and an IPMI endpoint. Also happy to run a pre-shipment smoke test and share logs.
Ana: Action items recap: Mike -> push run script + trace toggle; Kyle -> matrix CSV + parser; Shreya -> logistics + spreadsheet + partner sync; Ravi -> pre-shipment smoke test + thermocouple kit; benchbot -> validate schema on upload. We'll demo a preliminary heatmap by Fri the following week. Ping me for blockers. :rocket:
